scope: Corollary 20.2 (Entropy-production exponent) of the manuscript “Critical mixing in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model” (preprints/Critical-mixing-in-the-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-model-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3ac6296cc238bae9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 186. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every realization of the disorder, RJ 2 ≤ CEP,J ≤ CLS,J 4 . Consequently, for the critical zero-field Gaussian model, CEP,J = n2/3+o(1) in disorder probability, with the fixed exponent-slack meaning of Theorem 1.1. For every initial probability law ν on the cube and every t ≥ 0, KL(νetLJ ∥µJ ) ≤ e−t/CEP,J KL(ν∥µJ ) ≤ e−4t/CLS,J KL(ν∥µJ ).
